end_hold.label: Extra Time
end_hold.description: Display the last image for x seconds at the end of the video (0 = off)

fps.label: Video FPS
fps.description: Frames per second in the video

video_length.label: Maximum video length
video_length.description: Longest video to make in seconds (0 = unlimited)

ffmpeg_threads.label: Video Creation Load
ffmpeg_threads.description: Number of CPU cores to use for video creation (0 = automatic)

camera1_url.label: Camera 1 url
camera1_url.description: Camera1 snapshot url (preferred) or MJPEG stream url if snapshot not available

camera1_on.label: Enable Camera 1
camera1_on.description: Camera1 is used (off keeps the url but takes no images)

camera2_on.label: Enable Camera 2
camera2_on.description: Camera2 is used (off keeps the url but takes no images)

duet_ip.label: Printer IP address
duet_ip.description: Printer address (SBC or standalone). Blank = this computer

image_dir.label: Image folder
image_dir.description: Where images and videos are stored

allow_multiple_instances.label: Allow multiple instances
allow_multiple_instances.description: Let more than one duetLapse3 run on this computer. Each one must use a different settings folder

UI_port.label: Port
UI_port.description: Port for this page (0 = pick a free port)

open_browser.label: Open browser at startup
open_browser.description: Open this page in this computer's browser when duetLapse3 starts. Not used when running as a DWC plugin, or without a desktop

capture_seconds.label: Timed capture
capture_seconds.description: Take an image every n seconds (0 = off)

capture_on.label: Event capture
capture_on.description: When to take images: On layer change, When paused in print job, or Timed Only

layer_interval.label: Layers between capture
layer_interval.description: Take an image every n layers when Event capture = On layer change (with Park before image on, Layers between Park is used instead)

park.label: Park before image
park.description: Moves the head to the Park Location before each image

park_xy.label: Park Location
park_xy.description: Where to park the head (X, Y) with Park before image on, or Event capture set to When paused in print job. 0, 0 = don't move it

park_wait.label: Rest Time
park_wait.description: Seconds to wait after parking, before the image is captured

park_min_layers.label: Minimum Layers
park_min_layers.description: Minimum layers before park. No images are taken, and the print isn't paused, until the layer is above this

park_layer_interval.label: Layers between Park
park_layer_interval.description: With Park before image on, park and take an image every n layers, starting at the first layer above Minimum Layers. Layers between capture isn't used

start_mode.label: When to start
start_mode.description: When to start taking images. Event capture set to Timed Only, with Timed capture above 0, always starts straight away or at the Start command

norestart.label: No restart
norestart.description: Stop duetLapse3 when the print finishes, instead of getting ready for the next print job

no_log.label: Disable Logging
no_log.description: This is only useful if you are running duetLapse3 on a read-only filesystem.

verbose.label: Verbose Logging
verbose.description: VERY Detailed logging. Only useful for debugging.

delete_images.label: Delete Images
delete_images.description: Delete the image files when a print finishes, after its video is made (unless Keep Files is on)

keep_files.label: Keep Files
keep_files.description: Don't delete images when the program starts or a print finishes. Videos are always kept

printer.cannotConnect: Cannot connect to the printer at {printer}
printer.noMoreTries: The program will not try again until the printer settings are changed.
printer.keepsTrying: The program will keep trying. Check the printer is on, or change its ip and port settings.

settingsAlert.notApplied: These settings were not applied - the current ones are still in use

status.title: Status
status.imagesTwo: No. of captured images: Camera 1 - ({frames}), Camera 2 - ({frames2})
status.noCamera: No camera in use - set using the Cameras tab
status.waiting: Waiting for the first image to be captured
status.snapshot: The camera now - waiting for the first image to be captured

controls.title: Controls
controls.standbyConfirm:
Standby does NOT create a video.
All captured images will be deleted.
controls.restartConfirm:
Restart will try to create a video, read the settings again, then get ready for the next print.

The captured images are deleted the next time the program starts, unless Keep Files is on.
controls.forcedText:
Terminate straight away.
A video will NOT be created.

video.title: Make a video now
video.noneYet: No images have been captured yet
video.notEnough: Not enough images yet - {n} are needed
video.notEnoughEach: Not enough images yet - {n} are needed for each camera's video
video.minTooBig: Minimum video length can not be more than Maximum video length ({max})
video.maxTooSmall: Maximum video length must be 0 (off) or at least Minimum video length ({min})

cameras.checkUrls: Not saved - check the urls marked in red.
cameras.help: Use a snapshot url (preferred) or an MJPEG stream url. Save saves both cameras.

config.restartNeeded: Changes here take effect when you press Restart on the Status tab.

settingsForm.dontGoTogether: Some settings don't go together (marked in red) - nothing was saved.
settingsForm.dontGoTogetherShort: Some settings don't go together - nothing was saved.
settingsForm.invalid: Some settings are invalid (marked in red) - nothing was saved.
settingsForm.invalidShort: Some settings are invalid - nothing was saved.

images.name: Name
images.deleteFolder: The folder and everything in it ({contents}) will be deleted.

log.disabled: There is no logfile: Disable Logging is on (Config, File Settings tab).
log.truncated: Showing the end of the logfile - download it to see all of it.

server.savedRestart: Saved. The changes take effect when you press Restart on the Status tab.
server.savedVideo: Saved. The video settings are in use now.
server.savedCameras: Saved. The cameras are in use now.
server.savedConnecting: Saved - connecting to the printer at {printer}
server.notSavedInvalid: Not saved - some settings are invalid
server.conflictParkLocation: Park Location is only used with Park before image on, or Event capture set to When paused in print job
server.conflictParkPause: Park before image can not be used with Event capture set to When paused in print job - the print job makes its own pauses
server.settingBad: A saved setting has a value that can not be used - see the log
server.cameraOff: {camera} is off - no images will be taken from it
server.settingsUnreadableDefaults: Could not read the settings file - showing the defaults. {error}
server.notBool: {key} must be true or false, not {value}
server.notWhole: {key} must be a whole number, not {value}
server.notList: {key} must be a list of {count} numbers e.g. {example}
server.notChangeable: {key} can not be changed while running
server.minvideoTooBig: Minimum video length ({min}) can not be more than Maximum video length ({max})
server.maxvideoTooSmall: Maximum video length must be 0 (off) or at least Minimum video length ({min})
server.camera1Needed: Camera1 needs an http url (a snapshot url or an MJPEG stream url) - or switch it off
server.camera1NotHttp: Camera1 url must be an http url, or blank
server.camera2NotHttp: Camera2 url must be an http url, or blank for no second camera
server.wrongPassword: The printer at {printer} did not accept the password
server.videoNotEnough: Not enough images for video to be created
server.videoNoImages: Cannot create a video - there are no images in {folder}
server.videoTooShort: {camera}: not enough images for a video ({frames} - {needed} needed)
server.videoProblem: There was a problem creating the video for {camera} (see the log)
